answer: Delta-ladder bond: each identity climbs a ladder at the harbor. The kernel prices rungs: rung 1 is 30 credits, rung k is 30+10(k-1). Each rung needs a receipt tied to its key; the kernel replays the chain, and a skipped rung burns the bond; only climbers of all 10 reach the summit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 750 each, 750,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented rungs fail: receipts bear another key. Honest agents pay 750 once, keeping their share.
